_obs: Video longo do Wukong (formato do Pedro 15/11: 1 serie por longo). Partes = provas CLX01-05 publicadas como CL058-062. Sai sozinho depois da parte 5 (17/11 14h BRT).
titulo: The Monkey King: The Complete Story of Sun Wukong | Journey to the West
descricao:
Born from a stone. Taught by an immortal. He robbed a dragon king, erased his name from the Book of Death and fought all of Heaven, until the Buddha made him a bet he couldn't win.

The complete myth of Sun Wukong, all 5 parts in one video, plus what happened after Five Finger Mountain.

partes.rotulo: Part 3: The Dragon King and the Book of Death

feito.obs: 24/11: o 'feito' nao era gravado (push falhava) e o Wukong subiu de novo 11 vezes (18-23/11). Copias tiradas do ar pelo limpar_duplicados.
